analysis.headline: No Selling or Sharing Your Data
analysis.quote: We do not buy, sell, or share personal data about consumers.

analysis.headline: Shares IP Address with Google/Apple
analysis.quote: On Android, we rely on the Safe Browsing functionality built into the operating system. Any requests to Google servers made by this component (by the Brave app or by another app) will expose your device IP address to Google. On iOS, we use the Safe Browsing functionality provided by Safari. This functionality uses Google and Tencent Safe Browsing services depending on your region. Apple proxies requests to these services, exposing your device IP address to Apple.

analysis.headline: Wallet Transactions Share Your Data
analysis.quote: When you make a transaction using a third-party that redirects you to their services, such as an on-ramp partner, they will capture your IP address, wallet address, transaction and event data.

analysis.headline: DEX Aggregators Process Your Data
analysis.quote: We use Decentralised Exchange Aggregators (DEX) such as 0x for swaps made on EVM compatible blockchains and Jupiter for swaps completed on the Solana blockchain. They will also process your wallet address, related transaction data and your IP address but will ONLY use this data to fulfill the transaction (including getting a quote).

analysis.headline: Inca.Digital Accesses Your Transactions
analysis.quote: We use a third-party provider (Inca.Digital) to perform this service [periodic lookbacks of past transactions to meet compliance obligations] on our behalf.

analysis.headline: Fraud Data Retained Two Years
analysis.quote: In case of confirmed fraud, stored [IP address at time of claiming BAT] for up to 2 years.

analysis.headline: Rewards IDs Retained Four Years
analysis.quote: The duration of the user’s account, plus 4 years in order to comply with US Internal Revenue Service requirements.

analysis.headline: No AI Model Training On Your Chats
analysis.quote: We do not use your conversations for model training.

analysis.headline: Feedback May Include Personal Data
analysis.quote: Depending on the context, this may include personal information you provide to us directly, such as your name, email address, contact information, or contents of the feedback.

analysis.headline: Beta Crash Reports Can Contain PII
analysis.quote: These test versions of the Browser may automatically send crash reports to Brave so that we can identify and fix problems. A crash report can contain personal information.
